description: Wraps GET /api/house/history. Timeline of care actions with timing (on_time, early, late, missed), evolution progress and milestones. format=markdown returns a readable narrative.

creature_id.description: UUID of the creature whose history to fetch.

format.description: Response format. 'markdown' returns a text/markdown narrative; default is JSON.

limit.description: Max care log entries to return.

offset.description: Care log entries to skip, for paging back through a long history.

name: get_care_history
title: Care history
